text:
maria: Quick sync 16: ap-northeast GPU pool showing intermittent p99 spikes correlated with a tenant `matrix-ops` doing large KV-cache rebuilds + sustained egress. p50=9ms p95=41ms p99=360-700ms. Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/gpu/ap-northeast-3
oliver: Ugh. Any immediate mitigation we can push that is low-risk?
sam: We can try a lightweight scheduler steer + ToR egress shaping first. Label two racks `io-shield=true`, then annotate pods `io_class=heavy` and let scheduler prefer shield racks. Apply shaping: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 8gbit burst 64k latency 300ms`. No reserved infra cost for 48h canary.
maria: Sounds good. What's the success criteria?
sam: If p99 for normal multi-tenant slices drops >=30% within 6h and KV-cache miss rate on shield racks is lower, we keep and extend. Abort if p95 for normal slices rises >10%.
oliver: Who runs this? Sam + Maria to deploy, I'll watch cost/alerts. Also add packet capture for 30m after rollout.
infra-bot: alert: ap-northeast/gpu-pool p99 > 400ms for 8m tag="matrix-ops". Suggested action: egress-shield canary.
maria: I'll start labeling at 03:15 UTC and enable shaping. Will post run_id. Keep chatter short; dump logs to the canary thread.
sam: Rollback: remove labels `kubectl label nodes -l io-shield=true io-shield-` and `csd remove egress-shaper --run $run_id`.
maria: canary started run_id=io-shield-6167 at 6167770120.
